mandate: Response-guided Learning Rate Control Pilot: validate whether A0S controllability information converts into a useful fixed training control rule. First algorithm validation after mechanism discovery. Fixed pilot: no controller optimization, no hyperparameter tuning.

controller_frozen.rule: per cell: read frozen chi_lr; if chi_lr < 0 -> u=+0.05; if chi_lr > 0 -> u=-0.05; eta_new = eta_native_k * exp(u) applied at EVERY optimizer step of the window (persistent, A0O semantics)
controller_frozen.chi_source: FROZEN read-only: D1 = outputs/a0o_lr_response_validation_v01/runs/stage1_cells.jsonl h_eta (H==4); D2 = outputs/a0q_response_control_map_v01/runs/cells.jsonl h_lr. NOT recomputed.

D1.selection_rule: first two frozen A0O stage1 streams per state (result-independent)

D2.selection_rule: both frozen A0Q streams per state

arms.B: fixed LR perturbation u=+0.05 at every step, all cells
arms.C: response-guided: u = +0.05 if chi_lr<0 else -0.05 at every step

horizons.stream: one lookahead of 128 micro-batches per cell (batch_seed=derive_stream_seed(stream_seed,404), frozen A0K recipe); prefixes used for H=4 (8) and H=16 (32): batches_from_train_pool is a seeded permutation prefix, so windows are nested and matched

aliasing: on cells where action == +0.05, arm C's rollout is bitwise-identical to arm B's (same frozen function, u, stream, state, RNG) -> run once, alias, record aliased=true. This makes C-vs-B near-degenerate on these banks BY CONSTRUCTION (frozen A0S: chi_lr<0 in 46/48 D1 cells and 12/12 D2 cells); reported honestly, not hidden.
crn: arm A (u=0) run twice at H=4 per cell; bitwise equality required (all cells)

metrics.gain_X_H: L_A,H - L_X,H for X in {B,C}, H in {4,16,64}
stats: Wilcoxon signed-rank (two-sided) gain vs 0 and (gain_C - gain_B) vs 0
sign consistency: fraction(gain_C,H > 0), binomial test vs 0.5
metrics.thirds: rank cells by C_t WITHIN each dataset; split top/mid/bottom thirds; per-third success rate (fraction gain_C,H4>0) and median gain_C,H4; pooled D1+D2 via per-dataset table + combined counts
metrics.erosion: gain_C at H=16 and H=64 vs H=4 (short-vs-long; A0P linkage)

PASS_iff: (ii) sign consistency H4 > 0.5 AND binomial p < 0.05
(iii) median(gain_C - gain_B, H4) >= 0 (C not worse than fixed)
FAIL_cases: controller gain not significant vs native

csv.row_semantics: one row per (seed,step) state = stream-average over that state's cell(s); action = stream-majority action; loss_H* = arm C losses; gain = L_A,H4 - L_C,H4. Full per-cell detail (stream_seed, per-arm per-H losses, gains) in a0t_detail_supplementary.csv.

forbidden: change delta (0.05) or the H grid {4,16,64}
edit any frozen artifact or module
claim short-term gain = final training improvement
limitations_required_in_report: short-term (finite-H) gain does NOT equal final training improvement
A0P: long memory, non-exponential response kernel -> H=16/64 gains may not persist
absolute gains are tiny (A0S: G/L0 ~ 7e-5 at H=4)
C-vs-B near-degeneracy by construction on these banks (chi sign overwhelmingly negative)
stop_rule: STOP after experiment. Do not auto-launch any next round.
